LOGIN_PROBLEMS.NAME: Login problems
LOGIN_PROBLEMS.SUMMARY: See when login complaints start increasing.
LOGIN_PROBLEMS.CONDITION: A customer says they cannot sign in to their account, including failed password resets and verification codes that never arrive. Exclude questions about changing a password while already signed in.

MISSING_ORDER_UPDATES.NAME: Missing order updates
MISSING_ORDER_UPDATES.CONDITION: A customer says an order confirmation, shipping update, or delivery notice did not arrive, or arrived for the wrong order. Exclude customers asking where a parcel is when they did receive the tracking email.

COMPETITOR_MENTIONS.NAME: Competitor mentions
COMPETITOR_MENTIONS.SUMMARY: Find conversations worth following up on.
COMPETITOR_MENTIONS.CONDITION: A customer compares us with a competing product, says they are evaluating one, or mentions they may switch. Exclude customers who moved to us from a competitor and are asking how to import their data.

FEATURE_REQUESTS.NAME: Feature requests
FEATURE_REQUESTS.SUMMARY: Keep a running count of conversations about unmet needs.
FEATURE_REQUESTS.CONDITION: A customer asks for a capability the product does not currently offer, or asks whether something is possible and it is not. Exclude questions about how to use a feature that already exists.

REFUND_REQUESTS.NAME: Refund requests
REFUND_REQUESTS.SUMMARY: Bring a consistent definition to your weekly refund request count.
REFUND_REQUESTS.CONDITION: A customer asks for money back on a payment they already made, including duplicate charges and refunds after cancelling. Exclude questions about the refund policy and requests for a discount.

CANCELLATION_INTENT.NAME: Cancellation intent
CANCELLATION_INTENT.SUMMARY: Find customers who may need a conversation before they leave.
CANCELLATION_INTENT.CONDITION: A customer says they intend to cancel, will not renew, or plan to stop using the product. Exclude requests to reduce seats or downgrade, and cancellations the customer takes back in the same conversation.

PAYMENT_FAILURES.NAME: Payment failures
PAYMENT_FAILURES.SUMMARY: Spot customers who are blocked from paying.
PAYMENT_FAILURES.CONDITION: A customer says a payment, checkout, or invoice payment failed, or their card was declined. Exclude refund requests, disputes about completed charges, and general questions about payment methods.

PRODUCT_ERRORS.NAME: Product errors
PRODUCT_ERRORS.SUMMARY: See when errors and crashes start spreading.
PRODUCT_ERRORS.CONDITION: A customer reports an error, crash, unavailable service, or severe slowness that prevents them from completing a task. Exclude sign-in problems and questions about how to use a working feature.

ISSUE_STILL_UNRESOLVED.NAME: Issue still unresolved
ISSUE_STILL_UNRESOLVED.SUMMARY: Find conversations that need another pass.
ISSUE_STILL_UNRESOLVED.CONDITION: A customer says a suggested fix did not work, the same problem returned, or their issue remains after support said it was resolved. Exclude first-time reports and requests only asking for a status update.

ESCALATION_REQUESTS.NAME: Escalation requests
ESCALATION_REQUESTS.SUMMARY: Surface requests that need prompt attention.
ESCALATION_REQUESTS.CONDITION: A customer explicitly asks for a human agent, manager, specialist, or higher support tier because their issue has not been resolved. Exclude routine transfers and sales requests.

FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME.NAME: Tempo de primeira resposta
FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME.INFO_TEXT: Tempo médio entre a abertura da conversa e a primeira resposta de um agente. Considera apenas as conversas que receberam a primeira resposta dentro do período. Com o filtro de horário de expediente ligado, conta apenas o tempo dentro do horário de trabalho.

RESOLUTION_TIME.NAME: Tempo de resolução
RESOLUTION_TIME.INFO_TEXT: Tempo médio entre a abertura da conversa e o seu encerramento. Cada encerramento entra na média: uma conversa reaberta e encerrada novamente conta duas vezes. Com o filtro de horário de expediente ligado, conta apenas o tempo dentro do horário de trabalho.
RESOLUTION_TIME.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION: Based on {count} conversation | Based on {count} conversations
RESOLUTION_TIME.TOOLTIP_TEXT: O tempo da primeira resposta é {metricValue} (com base em {conversationCount} conversas)

RESOLUTION_COUNT.NAME: Conversas resolvidas
RESOLUTION_COUNT.INFO_TEXT: Quantas vezes uma conversa foi resolvida no período. Conta encerramentos, não conversas distintas: reabrir e resolver novamente conta duas vezes.

BOT_RESOLUTION_COUNT.NAME: Resolvidas pelo bot
BOT_RESOLUTION_COUNT.INFO_TEXT: Quantas vezes o bot resolveu uma conversa sem a encaminhar para um agente. Conta encerramentos, não conversas distintas.

BOT_HANDOFF_COUNT.NAME: Encaminhadas para agentes
BOT_HANDOFF_COUNT.INFO_TEXT: Quantas conversas distintas o bot encaminhou para um agente humano no período. Ao contrário dos outros contadores, encaminhamentos repetidos na mesma conversa contam uma única vez.

REPLY_TIME.NAME: Tempo de espera do cliente
REPLY_TIME.TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION: Based on {count} reply | Based on {count} replies
REPLY_TIME.TOOLTIP_TEXT: O tempo de espera é {metricValue} (com base em {conversationCount} conversas)
REPLY_TIME.INFO_TEXT: Tempo médio que o cliente espera entre a sua mensagem e a resposta seguinte do agente, considerando todas as respostas da conversa — não apenas a primeira. Com o filtro de horário de expediente ligado, conta apenas o tempo dentro do horário de trabalho.
